context_type: Creative SaaS App / Game Engine Workspace

visual_enhancers.code_editor_style: bg-[#0a0b0e] border border-slate-800 rounded-lg font-mono text-cyan-300 p-4

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete, fully interactive, dark workspace web application inspired by MELTY.
The primary AI model must be clearly labeled as 'Kimi K3' across the prompt bar, chat panel, and token cost metrics.
Provide top workspace mode tabs: 'Project Library', 'Fusion Studio' (Main Editor), 'Asset Vault', 'Code & File Tree', and 'Budget & Analytics'.

In the Fusion Studio, create a multi-column responsive workspace with: 1) Left panel for Reference Cards + Aspect Toggles + Blend Slider + PC Import Helper CTA, 2) Central Playable Preview iframe/canvas (toggleable 2D Phaser & 3D Three.js live minigames with playable controls WASD/Arrows), 3) Right panel tabs for AI Chat (Kimi K3 prompt stream), Live Game-Design Summary (GDD specs auto-generated), Code Editor, and Version History Checkpoints.
Implement the 'Import games from my PC' helper modal with copyable CLI script ('npx melty-pc-scan --json'), drag-and-drop local JSON upload area, and sample game detection results.
Ensure the Budget Meter prominently shows the $9.00 daily spend ceiling, real-time Kimi K3 token burn, spend breakdown per generation, and alert thresholds.
Include functional Export Zip downloading simulation (generates downloadable game bundle file) and Share Link modal with copyable public URL & QR code preview.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, sliders, cards, tabs, modals) MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='blend-slider', data-testid='kimi-k3-send-button').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid AI slop: do NOT use standard white/light grey boxes or plain Inter font for headings. Use Outfit font with electric cyan and hyper violet accent strokes.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdown menus, headers, or overlays. Always use high contrast dark surfaces like bg-[#0f1118] with backdrop-blur-xl.
DO NOT center-align main app text. Maintain left-aligned, high-density IDE hierarchy.
Ensure all buttons have hover/active states with glowing transitions and data-testid attributes.
Include real playable interactive 2D (HTML Canvas / Phaser logic) and 3D (Three.js canvas scene) renderers inside the iframe container so users can physically play the generated games in real-time.

grids.workspace_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] p-4
grids.left_sidebar_span: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-y-auto
grids.center_preview_span: col-span-12 lg:col-span-6 flex flex-col gap-3 h-full
grids.right_panel_span: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col gap-4 h-full overflow-hidden
grids.project_grid: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 p-6

accessibility.aria_roles: Ensure sliders use role='slider', tabs use role='tablist', and buttons include readable title/aria-label.
accessibility.contrast_ratio: Text colors guarantee WCAG AA 4.5:1 against dark surface #0f1118.

3d_libraries.three_js: Use Three.js (installed/imported) for 3D interactive preview canvas.
3d_libraries.phaser_2d: Use HTML5 Canvas element with interactive game loops for 2D game preview.
